name: The Ogres of Feralas
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Now that you have proven that you are a true fighter, I trust that you possess the courage to continue with the task at hand.

Travel to the High Wilderness, southwest of here. There lie some abandoned and destroyed structures, on land that once belonged to the night elves. Look for these ruins, and when you see the withered trees and desecrated terrain, you will find the Gordunni. Push them back.

These ogres are much stronger than the ones you faced previously, adventurer. Be aware.
narrative.objectives: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Shaman, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have proven yourself to be a trustworthy and dependable ally, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found the ruins, adventurer?
